The Magic Template SDK, also known as CutSame SDK, is a powerful and versatile tool designed to simplify and enhance the video editing process. This guide provides the initial steps and prerequisites to begin using Magic Template for Android, ensuring a smooth setup and understanding of its functionalities.

<span id="dc5df83c"></span>
# Prerequisites

Before you begin, ensure that the following requirements are met:


* Your application is intended for devices that are Android 5.0 or later.

* You have obtained a valid Magic Template SDK license.

* You have obtained the account username and password required to access Magic Template SDK, which is stored in a Maven repository. For more information about obtaining these credentials, contact your technical support manager.


<span id="1ac14525"></span>
# Magic Template SDK introduction

Version number：5.0.1\-rc.5\-v130


|**Name** |**Coordinate** |**Description** |
|---|---|---|
|CutSame SDK |com.volcengine.ck.cutsame:CK\-CutSameIF |The Magic Template consumption SDK, responsible for template replay, update, and synthesis. |


```Kotlin
// build.gradle
dependencies {
    implementation "com.volcengine.ck.cutsame:CK-CutSameIF:${version}"
}
```


<span id="113bb81c"></span>
# API process overview

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="8072ca50"></span>
## Retrieve template list

The obtained data primarily consists of template information (template title, template preview video, and others). It serves two main purposes: first, to provide data for page display information; second, to build the necessary `TemplateItem` for subsequent template replay processes.

<span id="05b49a48"></span>
## Retrieve template slot information

Subsequent material selection and template replay both require template slot information. This information includes material path, material type, materialId (the slot ID of the template), and more. For details, refer to the definition of `MediaItem` in the section on obtaining template media materials.

To retrieve the template slot information, use `prepareSource()` in `CutSameSource` to obtain `List<MediaItem>`.

<span id="a75a5422"></span>
## Fill template slot information

Primarily fill in the relevant fields of `MediaItem`, such as `source`, `mediaSrcPath`, `type`, and `oriDuration`. For details, refer to the definition of `MediaItem`in the section on obtaining template media materials. Focus on the parts that require business\-specific assignments.

<span id="860fd13e"></span>
## Material composition processing

After the step of filling template slot information, you need to call the `CutSameSource.composeSource()` for material composition processing, which mainly includes:


* Compressing the materials to reduce resolution and improve replay efficiency.

* According to the template production rules, perform reverse playback processing of materials as needed.


<span id="af2f99b9"></span>
## Template replay

After the above steps, pass the `List<MediaItem>` into the `CutSamePlayer.preparePlay()`, set the `PlayerStateListener` to monitor the changes. When the state is `PLAYER_STATE_PREPARED`, you can call the `start()` interface to perform the replay .
